job.title: Product Manager - Knees - East Coast
job.description:
Product Manager – Knee | Orthopaedics

Sydney preferred | East Coast considered

Ready to take your orthopaedic career in a different direction?

A leading global orthopaedic organisation is looking for a Product Manager to take ownership of a highly regarded knee reconstruction portfolio, with several exciting new product introductions on the horizon.

This isn't just a portfolio-maintenance role. With new products already entering the market and further launches planned, you'll have the opportunity to work closely with surgeons, sales teams and internal stakeholders to help shape strategy, drive adoption and successfully bring new technology to market.

And importantly, you don't necessarily need to be a Product Manager already.

If you're currently working in orthopaedic sales, particularly across knee or joint reconstruction, and have been considering a move into marketing, this could be an excellent next career step.

The opportunity

You'll take ownership across key areas of the primary and revision knee portfolio, combining strategic product management with genuine field and customer engagement.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Leading and project-managing new product introductions
  • Developing portfolio strategy and key commercial messages
  • Working directly with orthopaedic surgeons to understand customer needs and drive adoption
  • Partnering closely with the sales team to translate strategy into field execution
  • Managing portfolio, inventory and asset requirements
  • Working collaboratively with local and global stakeholders
  • Supporting commercial growth across the knee portfolio
  • Helping drive engagement around new products, technologies and clinical solutions

This is not a purely desk-based marketing position. You'll remain closely connected to surgeons, customers and the commercial team, making it particularly attractive to someone who enjoys the customer-facing side of orthopaedics.

Who we're looking for

The ideal candidate would bring both knee reconstruction and product marketing experience, but we recognise that's a relatively rare combination.

Orthopaedic knowledge is the priority.

We'd therefore be interested in speaking with:

  • Existing Product Managers within orthopaedics
  • Knee or joint reconstruction sales professionals looking to transition into marketing
  • Candidates with strong hip/joints experience
  • High-quality candidates from adjacent orthopaedic portfolios such as trauma or sports medicine

You'll need strong communication and influencing skills, commercial awareness and the ability to build credibility with both surgeons and experienced sales professionals.

Most importantly, you'll need the curiosity and learning agility to move beyond your immediate area of expertise and take genuine ownership of a portfolio.

Why consider it?

For someone coming from field sales, this is an opportunity to broaden your career without walking away from orthopaedics, surgeons or the commercial side of the industry.

You'll gain exposure to portfolio strategy, product launches, NPI project management and broader commercial decision-making while being supported by an experienced marketing team.

For an existing Product Manager, the attraction is equally strong: meaningful portfolio ownership, multiple upcoming launches and the opportunity to influence the direction and growth of an important orthopaedic portfolio.

Location: Sydney preferred, although strong candidates elsewhere on the East Coast will be considered.

If you're already in orthopaedics and have wondered what a move into product management could look like, this is a great opportunity to explore it.

Contact Jonathan Gertler at OneMD for a confidential discussion. 0406 423 734

job.title: Equipment Specialist, Community (Eastern Suburbs)

  • Discounted BUPA private health insurance.

The Company

A major Australian healthcare equipment supplier is looking for a personable and motivated Territory Manager to promote products in their community portfolio, covering Sydney CBD and the Eastern Suburbs.

The business supports people across community care, aged care and hospital settings, providing equipment that helps improve mobility, independence, comfort and quality of life.

This is a great opportunity for someone who is hungry to learn, enjoys building relationships and is keen to get stuck into sales. You’ll have the chance to develop your sales skills, learn how to grow your own territory and build a rewarding career in medical device sales.

Territory: Sydney CBD & Eastern Suburbs

This is a hands-on, field-based sales role where you’ll take ownership of an existing territory, manage your own schedule and identify opportunities to grow the business across the community healthcare sector.

You’ll spend your time visiting occupational therapists, home care providers, retirement villages and other community healthcare contacts, introducing them to the company’s product range and helping them find the right equipment to support people in their homes and local communities.

The portfolio includes a range of assistive healthcare equipment, including beds, recliners, mobility scooters, walkers and patient lifters. You’ll conduct product demonstrations, coordinate equipment trials and provide ongoing customer support.

You’ll be supported by an office-based team who assist with administration and equipment logistics, allowing you to focus on developing your territory and delivering results.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Identifying new business opportunities and proactively developing the territory.
  • Building and maintaining relationships with occupational therapists, home care providers, retirement villages and other community healthcare contacts.
  • Conducting customer visits, equipment trials and product demonstrations in patients’ homes and community settings.
  • Working towards sales targets and growing revenue across your territory.
  • Providing excellent customer service to encourage repeat business and long-term relationships.
  • Coordinating equipment trials, customer follow-ups, deliveries, collections and returns.
  • Managing multiple customer requests while maintaining accurate records and stock control.

About You

This opportunity is ideal for someone who is eager to learn, enjoys a varied, hands-on role and is looking to build a career in sales. You don’t need previous medical device or healthcare experience - what matters most is your attitude, initiative and willingness to get out in the field and give it a go.

You’ll receive training and support to learn the products and industry, so this could suit someone starting out in their career or looking to take their existing customer-facing experience in a new direction.

A relevant degree in Exercise Science, Medical Science or Exercise Physiology would be highly regarded, but isn’t essential.

To be successful in this role, you’ll:

  • Have a positive, proactive attitude and a genuine willingness to learn.
  • Be confident communicating with a range of people and comfortable working with minimal supervision.
  • Be organised and able to manage competing priorities throughout the day.
  • Be practical and hands-on, with the ability to load, unload, transport and demonstrate equipment.
  • Be comfortable using computer systems to manage customer interactions and administrative tasks.
  • Hold a current Australian driver’s licence and be happy to travel regularly throughout the territory.

Previous sales or customer-facing experience will be highly regarded, but we’re open to candidates from a range of backgrounds who have the right attitude and potential.
